title: The rules for choosing a navigable "_parent" lets a cross-origin child navigate a parent != top, but implementations block it

labels.name: interop
labels.description: Implementations are not interoperable with each other

body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

Assume a page with two nested iframes
```
Main document (Origin A)
      |---> iframe1 (Origin A)
               |---> iframe2 (Origin B)
```

when iframe2 is cross origin from iframe1 and iframe2._parent != iframe2._top and try to run
```js
window.open(URL,"_parent")
```
most browsers stops the navigation and mark it as unsafe
but the specs allows it (as per rules of choosing the _parent)


the rules for choosing a navigable


1) [Let targetNavigable and windowType be the result of applying the rules for choosing a navigable given target, sourceDocument's node navigable, and noopener.](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:the-rules-for-choosing-a-navigable:~:text=Let%20targetNavigable%20and%20windowType%20be%20the%20result%20of%20applying%20the%20rules%20for%20choosing%20a%20navigable%20given%20target%2C%20sourceDocument%27s%20node%20navigable%2C%20and%20noopener%2E)

2) [Otherwise, if name is an ASCII case-insensitive match for "_parent", set chosen to currentNavigable's parent, if any, and currentNavigable otherwise.](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#navigable-target-names:nav-parent-3:~:text=Otherwise%2C%20if%20name%20is%20an%20ASCII%20case%2Dinsensitive%20match%20for%20%22%5Fparent%22%2C%20set%20chosen%20to%20currentNavigable%27s%20parent%2C%20if%20any%2C%20and%20currentNavigable%20otherwise)
**in our case this resolves parent**

3)  [If sourceDocument's node navigable is not allowed by sandboxing to navigate navigable given sourceSnapshotParams... If exceptionsEnabled is true, then throw a "SecurityError" DOMException. 2. Return.](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#beginning-navigation:allowed-to-navigate:~:text=If%20sourceDocument%27s%20node%20navigable%20is%20not%20allowed%20by%20sandboxing%20to%20navigate%20navigable%20given%20sourceSnapshotParams%3A)
**in our case this is not sandboxed**

4)  [If target is not a top-level traversable, then return true.](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#preventing-navigation:top-level-traversable:~:text=If%20target%20is%20not%20a%20top%2Dlevel%20traversable%2C%20then%20return%20true)
**in our case its not top-level**
